failures.quote: When Marbury's analysis hit the paper in Y3C7, Richards was standing by the cold-drink cooler at the corner market on 34th Avenue.
failures.ledgerSays: The piece is bylined to Hal Richmond and Elliot Marbury (line 3). Marbury appears as a named source throughout his own piece: he is cited as author of the C111 dossier (lines 41, 49) and named again at line 109 ('Elliot Marbury charted on a spreadsheet'). A reporter may not be a source in their own piece. Both bylines do exist on the ledger (POP-00007 Hal Richmond, Senior Historian; POP-00166 Elliot Marbury, Data Desk).

notes: Six of the seven failures are small and fixable (cut the San Antonio history and the 'since they were twenty-two' line; cite the right column/cycle for Slayer, which is Y2C33; fix at-bats vs PA and the 80-100 range; drop Marbury as a source of his own piece). The C114 Mets/Philadelphia/Citi Field game scene is the structural problem: Y3C10 is the A's off-season and the record has no Mets games at all, so the closing scene needs to move to a non-game errand, or be set where the record has games.
